# Privacy Policy

_Note: This document is only available in English, as it is the official language of commerce for the regions in which we operate. Any translated copies are not valid._

Harmony Healthcare IT (“Harmony”, “we”, or “us”) knows that you care how information about you is used and shared.  This policy describes the types of information we may collect from you or that you may provide when you visit [www.harmonyhit.com](https://www.harmonyhit.com/) (our “Website”) and our practices for collecting, using, maintaining, protecting, and disclosing that information.  This Privacy Policy applies to information:

- On this website.
- In email, text, and other electronic messages between you and this Website.

It does not apply to information collected by:

- US offline or through any other means, including on any other website operated by Harmony or any third party; or
- Any third party, including through any application or content (including advertising) that may link to or be accessible from or through the Website.

Please read this policy carefully to understand our policies and practices regarding your information and how we treat it. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, your choice is to not use our Website. By accessing or using this Website, you agree to this privacy policy. This policy may change from time to time. Your continued use of this Website after we make changes is deemed acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.

1. **Information We Collect About You and How We Collect It**



(a) Our Service:  We may collect personally identifiable information about you, such as your full name, email address, phone number, or similar, when you sign up for the mailing list or request information from our “Resources” page.  When you use the Website, we may receive certain information about you as described below.  We send emails to those who have signed up for the mailing list or requested information from our “Resources” page and maintain records and copies of your correspondence.  If you no longer wish to receive such emails, you may opt out of them by clicking the link at the bottom of an email received from Harmony or by contacting Harmony at info@harmonyhit.com.



(b) Cookies and Tracking Technologies: Technologies such as: cookies, beacons, pixel tags, and scripts are used by Harmony.  These technologies may be used in analyzing trends, administering the Website, tracking your movements around the Website and to gather demographic information about our user base as a whole.  Information tracked by technologies may include personal information. We use cookies to identify users of the Website in order to reach out to prospective customers, advertise to web visitors, for general analytics, and in the furtherance of Harmony’s other legitimate interests generally.  Users can control the use of cookies at the individual browser level.  If you reject cookies, you may still use our Website with no negative effect.



(c) This website uses Act-On, Propensity, Factors.AI, HotJar, StackAdapt, LinkedIn, Meta and Google Analytics to track user activity, content consumption, engagement metrics, IP address, geolocation data, browser/system information, other websites visited, and detection of other first-party cookies. This information is gathered from all users and visitors. Your IP address and anonymized user data may be shared with third parties in the scope of building marketing analytic profiles. We process and keep all data for our own website within the United States of America and, if you wish to opt-out from tracking by Harmony, you can do so via email at [info@harmonyhit.com](mailto:info@HarmonyHIT.com) or by calling (800) 781-1044. Furthermore, each third party operates independently from us and has their own privacy policy, which we strongly suggest you review. Some of these tools may be used to track information about your behavior on our website depending on your region. For more information or to opt-out, please visit the respective website(s) of these vendors or contact us at [info@harmonyhit.com](mailto:info@HarmonyHIT.com).





(d) Harmony does not collect sensitive information about you.

2. **How We Use Your Information**



(a) We may use information that we collect about you or that you provide to us, including any personal information:

To present our Website and its contents to you.

To provide you with information, products, or services that you request from us.

To fulfill any other purpose for which you provide it.

In any other way we may describe when you provide the information.

To display targeted advertising content

For any other purpose with your consent.



We may also use your information, in combination with other information available to us about you from third-parties, to contact you about our own products and services that may be of interest to you. If you do not want us to use your information this way, please contact [info@harmonyhit.com](mailto:info@harmonyhit.com).



(b) We use the information that we collect to operate and maintain our Website and for marketing and advertising purposes.  The legal basis is Harmony’s legitimate interests identified in this policy under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act of Canada (PIPEDA), and applicable United States privacy laws.



(c) If you have signed up for emails or other resources from us, we use the information that we collect to send you such materials.  The legal basis is Harmony’s legitimate interest identified in this policy under GDPR, PIPEDA, and applicable United States privacy laws.

3. **How We Share Your Information**



(a) Personally Identifiable Information:  Harmony will not rent or sell your personally identifiable information to others.  We may store personal information in locations outside the direct control of Harmony (for example, information collected with Act-On will be stored by Act-On which has an interface into our Customer Relationship Management system).  Our blog is administered through a third-party application, WordPress, through a third-party web design firm, ONE18MEDIA, located in the U.S.; however, Harmony controls its blog.  No comments are allowed on Harmony’s blog, so no possibility exists of personal information being shared through Website user actions.  We will not post Website user information on the blog.



(b) Non-Personally Identifiable Information:  We will not share non-personally identifiable information with any third-parties.  Only Harmony has access to this information.  Non-personally identifiable information may be stored indefinitely.



(c) Instances Where We Are Required to Share Your Information:  Harmony will disclose your information where required to do so by law, if subject to subpoena or other legal proceeding or if we reasonably believe that such action is necessary to (a) comply with the law and the reasonable requests of law enforcement; (b) to enforce our Terms of Service or to protect the security or integrity of the services Harmony provides; and/or (c) to exercise or protect the rights, property, or personal safety of Harmony, our Website users, or others.



(d) What Happens in the Event of a Change of Control:  We may buy or sell/divest/transfer the company (including any shares in the company), or any combination of its products, services, assets and/or businesses.  Your information collected through the Website may be among the items sold or otherwise transferred in these types of transactions.  We may also sell, assign or otherwise transfer such information in the course of corporate divestitures, mergers, acquisitions, bankruptcies, dissolutions, reorganizations, liquidations, similar transactions or proceedings involving all or a portion of the company.  Website users who have signed up for the email list or other resources will be notified via email; all Website users will be notified via a prominent notice on our Website of any change in ownership or uses of your personal information, as well as any choices you may have regarding your personal information.



(e) Other: To fulfill the purpose for which you provide it, any other purpose disclosed by us when you provide the information, or with your consent.

4. **Storage and Processing.** Your information collected through the Website may be stored and processed in the United States, Europe, or any other country in which Harmony or its affiliates or service providers maintain facilities.  Harmony may transfer information that we collect about you, including personal information, to affiliated entities, or to other third parties across borders and from your country or jurisdiction to other countries or jurisdictions around the world.  If you are located in the European Union or the European Economic Area, please note that we will only transfer information, including personal data, to areas allowed by the GDPR and other privacy laws.
5. **How We Protect Your Information.** Harmony is concerned with protecting your privacy and data, but we cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to Harmony or guarantee that your information gathered through the Website may not be accessed disclosed, altered or destroyed by breach of any of our industry standard physical, technical or managerial safeguards.  No method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure.  Therefore, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.  If you have any questions about security on our Website, you can contact us at [info@HarmonyHIT.com](mailto:info@HarmonyHIT.com).
6. **Cookie Policy.** Some countries require websites to be very explicit about which cookies they use and for what purpose, especially with the EU cookie law.  Here is a full list of the cookies Harmony uses.  These cookies are essential for the continuance of our business.  We don’t use third party cookies or any other client storage mechanism:



Wp 18236:  1st party cookie:  does not expire:  picks up the company/ISP, area code, State/Province

7. **GDPR and PIPEDA.** We comply with GDPR as it applies to EU/EEA residents, PIPEDA as it applies to Canadian residents, and other applicable law as it applies to all Website users
8. **State Privacy Rights.** State consumer privacy laws may provide their residents with additional rights regarding our use of their personal information. HHIT collects information where individuals are acting in their role as employee for an organization. This privacy policy addresses California residents’ privacy rights.
9. **Compromise of Personal Information.** In the event that personal information is compromised as a breach of security, Harmony will promptly notify Website users in compliance with applicable law.
10. **Your Choices About Your Information.** If you wish to access a copy of or amend any personal information we hold about your, or to request that we delete or transfer any information about you that we have obtained through the methods described in this Privacy Policy, you may contact us at [info@HarmonyHIT.com](mailto:info@HarmonyHIT.com).  At your request, we may have any reference to you deleted or blocked in our database. We may not accommodate a request to change information we believe would violate any law or legal requirement or cause the information to be correct. Harmony will not discriminate against any individual for exercising these rights.
11. **Enforcement and Dispute Resolution.** At any time, you may object to the processing of your personal information, on legitimate grounds, except if otherwise permitted by applicable law.  If you believe your right to privacy granted by applicable data protection laws has been infringed upon, please contact Harmony’s data protection officer, Bridget Group, at (800) 781-1044.  You also have a right to lodge a complaint with data protection authorities.
12. **Our Retention of Your Information.** We will retain your information for as long as necessary, in some instances longer than six (6) years after your last visit to our Website.
13. **Children’s Privacy.** Protecting the privacy of young children is especially important.  For that reason, Harmony does not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from anyone under the age of 16.  If you are under 16 years of age, then please do not use or access the Website at any time or in any manner.  In the event that we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under age 16 and without verifiable parental consent, we will delete that information as quickly as possible.  If you believe that we might have any information from or about a child under 16, please contact us at [info@HarmonyHIT.com](mailto:info@HarmonyHIT.com)
14. **Links to Other Websites.** We are not responsible for the practices employed by websites or services linked to or from the Website, including the information or content contained therein.  Please remember that when you use a link to go from the Website to another website or service, our Privacy Policy does not apply to third-party websites or services.  Your browsing and interaction on any third-party website or service, including those that have a link or advertisement on our website, are subject to that third party’s own rules and policies.
15. **Changes to Our Privacy Policy.** All changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.  When we change the policy in a material manner, we will let you know via email (if you have opted in to receive emails or other resources) or a prominent notice on our Website, prior to the change becoming effective and update the ‘effective date’ at the top of this page.

Please abide by your company’s privacy policy as you access data in any product offered by Harmony Healthcare IT. Direct questions on your company’s privacy policy to your legal department.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, the practices of this Site, or your dealings with this website, please contact us at [info@HarmonyHIT.com](mailto:info@HarmonyHIT.com), or send mail to:

Harmony Healthcare IT

Attn: Privacy Officer

P.O. Box 6595

South Bend, Indiana 46660

**Supplemental Notice for U.S. State Privacy Rights**

This section supplements the information contained in our Privacy Policy and applies solely to residents of U.S. states with enacted consumer privacy laws, including but not limited to California, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, and Virginia. These laws provide residents with specific rights regarding their personal information. The rights described below may vary depending on your state of residence.

**Your Privacy Rights**

Depending on your state of residence, you may have the right to:

- **Access** the personal information we collect about you.
- **Correct** inaccuracies in your personal information.
- **Delete** personal information we have collected from you.
- **Opt out** of:

  - The sale or sharing of your personal information.
  - Targeted advertising.
  - Profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.
- **Appeal** a denial of your privacy rights request.

**How to Exercise Your Rights**

To exercise any of the rights described above, please contact us at:

- Email: [info@harmonyhit.com](mailto:info@HarmonyHIT.com)
- Phone: (800) 781-1044

We will verify your identity before processing your request and respond within the timeframe required by applicable law. If we deny your request, you may appeal the decision by contacting us using the same methods above.

**Authorized Agents**

If you are a California resident, you may designate an authorized agent to make a request on your behalf. We may require the agent to provide proof of authorization and verify your identity directly with us.

**Non-Discrimination**

We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your privacy rights. This includes denying you goods or services, charging you different prices or rates, or providing you a different level or quality of goods or services.

**Notice of Collection and Use**

We collect the categories of personal information described in the “Information We Collect About You and How We Collect It” section of our Privacy Policy. We use and disclose this information for the purposes described in the “How We Use Your Information” and “How We Share Your Information” sections.
